sources.title: Ahimanikya Satapathy’s February 2009 photographic archive
sources.note: Camera metadata records 18 February 2009; the accompanying email is dated 19 February. The email supplies the quoted recollection. The archive contains 161 main art views and five alternatives; six unrelated event photographs remain outside this gallery. “Fresco” is the collection name, not a verified painting technique.

sources.title: Bhubaneswar Smart City Limited — I Am Bhubaneswar
sources.note: Historical STAMP project account: over 200,000 sq ft and four flyover underpasses. It describes a later programme, not the 2009 works.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism — Raghurajpur
sources.note: Documents Pattachitra, palm-leaf engraving, wooden toys and masks at Raghurajpur. The palm-leaf mural supplies its own visible craft label.

sources.title: Odisha State Tribal Museum — Saora
sources.note: The culture and crafts account describes ceremonial idital and painting on paper and canvas for sale.

sources.title: Government of Odisha — Jhoti, Chita, Muruja
sources.note: Describes pithau rice paste, household walls and floors, and Lakshmi worship in Margasira.

sources.title: Ministry of Tourism / Incredible India — Bali Jatra
sources.note: Records Cuttack’s Mahanadi setting, Kartika Purnima and the festival’s commemoration of Sadhaba voyages.

sources.title: Puri district — Pipili
sources.note: Describes Ratha Yatra chariot cloths, umbrellas, bags and wall hangings.

sources.title: Government of Odisha — Dhenkanal, Handicraft (Dhokra), page 1
sources.note: Page 1, “The Lost-Wax Technique”: clay core, wax model, mould, heating and replacement of wax by molten metal.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Sun Temple, Konârak
sources.note: Description and Outstanding Universal Value: the 13th-century Sun Temple, 24 wheels, musicians and dancers; inscription dated 1984.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism — Lingaraj Temple
sources.note: Dates Lingaraj Temple to the 11th century. This date applies to the temple, not the photographs or unidentified painted buildings.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism — Arts and Crafts
sources.note: The craft overview includes wood, stone, terracotta, brass and bell metal, horn work and Dhokra.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism — Culture, Music & Dance
sources.note: The Odissi section identifies it as a classical dance from Odisha. It does not identify the painted performers.

selection_basis: Captions describe directly inspected photographs; cultural comparisons are expanded in the corresponding source-backed connections. Documentary images retained unchanged.
review_limit: Same-assistant source and image review, not independent specialist or artist confirmation.
